What degraded

  • The deck shipped at the round cap at 6.87 after five panel rounds, 1.13 under the 8.0 top rung. The art median was 6.5 and the craft floor stood down.
  • The first build read the Dallas Morning News through www.govtech.com, which names ClaudeBot with Disallow / for the whole host. Every govtech claim was withdrawn and the deck re-sourced to FOX 4, Dallas Express and the city's briefing. The October committee briefing's outcome is carried by no allowed host, so the deck has no dated next step.
  • Same docket item as carousel no. 31 on September 21st, outside the 30 day window. Every judge charged variety for it.
  • Frame 7's fans of 39 and 18 citation cards stand about 1.55 to 1 on screen against 2.17, and read as slabs at feed size.
  • The boundary re-measure requested one page each on www.newschannel6now.com and www.fox34.com, which robots.txt disallows to this project. Nothing was used. Disclosed in the field log.
  • Not merged: PRs 455 to 460 are unmerged and wait on PR 461, which waits on a daily merge. Image links point at the run branch.

Named here rather than left out. A run that quietly ships less than it planned teaches nobody anything.

Post this

Upload the PDF to LinkedIn as a document, title it Dallas AI cameras on brush trucks flag concerns, not violations, paste the post copy under it, then paste the first comment within a minute of posting.

carousel.pdf   contact sheet   the site

1. The post copy

3,700 courtesy notices. 57 citations. Not the same thing.

Cameras on Dallas sanitation trucks scanned 10,000 properties, the city's September 8th memo says, as FOX 4 reported. The memo says code officers reviewed and confirmed the detections behind the 57 citations, and that a citation comes only after an officer inspects the property and notifies the owner, Dallas Express and FOX 4 reported.

39 of the 57 citations were in Council Districts 4, 8 and 7 in southern Dallas, by the city manager's memo. Council member Chad West withdrew a move to cut the funding once the city manager's office agreed to brief the council.

The city's December 2025 briefing describes a three-year contract at $852,000 a year, subject to annual City Council appropriations. What should the council see before it funds another year?

#DallasCityCouncil #SouthernDallas #CodeCompliance

Notes

OWNER DECISIONS. (1) Merge PR 461 despite its red record step so the November 1st to 7th daily chain can go green and merge in order. (2) main already carries govtech claims (tx-2026-0179 c15 to c23, tx-2026-0037 c1 to c4) and NBC 5 claims on tx-2026-0179 from earlier runs. This run removed none. (3) govtech.com and dallasobserver.com both name ClaudeBot with Disallow / and belong in SOURCES_REGISTRY.md, which is human lane. Hard fails repaired, one per round: govtech provenance (1), the caption printing the city's process unattributed (2), an unsourced month for West's withdrawal (3), a stale contact sheet and thumbs (4). Round 5 found none.

This is a draft. Nothing was sent. The deck did NOT merge, so nothing here is on main and there is nothing to post. The links resolve against the run branch for as long as it exists.
